aircraft.callsignSpoken: Cessna one two three Sierra Quebec

taxi.description: Pilot is parked at the main ramp and requests taxi for closed traffic.
taxi.expectedCall: Squawk Tower, Cessna one two three Sierra Quebec, at the main ramp with information Alpha, request taxi for closed traffic.
taxi.expectedReadback: Runway two seven, taxi via Alpha, hold short runway two seven, Cessna three Sierra Quebec.
taxi.atcReply: Cessna one two three Sierra Quebec, Squawk Tower, runway two seven, taxi via Alpha, hold short runway two seven.
taxi.atcExpected: Tower should give the runway, the taxi route, and an explicit hold short instruction.
safetyCritical: Hold short instructions must be read back.
Pilot must not taxi onto or across a runway without clearance.

takeoff.description: Pilot is holding short of runway 27 and is ready to depart, remaining in the pattern.
takeoff.expectedCall: Squawk Tower, Cessna three Sierra Quebec, holding short runway two seven, ready for departure, remaining in the pattern.
takeoff.expectedReadback: Runway two seven, cleared for takeoff, left closed traffic, Cessna three Sierra Quebec.
takeoff.atcReply: Cessna three Sierra Quebec, runway two seven, cleared for takeoff, make left closed traffic.
takeoff.atcExpected: Tower should state the runway, 'cleared for takeoff', and the pattern direction.
safetyCritical: Takeoff clearance must be read back with the runway.
Wrong runway in a call or readback is a safety issue.
Pilot must not take off without a clearance.

pattern.description: Pilot is midfield left downwind runway 27 and wants a full-stop landing.
pattern.expectedCall: Squawk Tower, Cessna three Sierra Quebec, midfield left downwind runway two seven, full stop.
pattern.expectedReadback: Report left base, Cessna three Sierra Quebec.
pattern.atcReply: Cessna three Sierra Quebec, number one, report left base runway two seven.
pattern.atcExpected: Tower should give a sequence number and a reporting point.
safetyCritical: Wrong pattern direction or wrong runway is a safety issue.

landing.description: Pilot is on left base runway 27 and reports in for landing.
landing.expectedCall: Squawk Tower, Cessna three Sierra Quebec, left base runway two seven, full stop.
landing.expectedReadback: Cleared to land runway two seven, Cessna three Sierra Quebec.
landing.atcReply: Cessna three Sierra Quebec, runway two seven, cleared to land.
landing.atcExpected: Tower should state the runway and 'cleared to land'.
safetyCritical: Landing clearance must be read back with the runway.
Pilot must not land without a clearance.
